<div class="function-reference" markdown="1">

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`unsigned long millis()`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-millis)<br><small>*Example:* `unsigned long now = millis();`</small> | Read elapsed time in ms; use unsigned subtraction to time actions across clock wraparound. |
| [`unsigned long micros()`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-micros)<br><small>*Example:* `unsigned long nowUs = micros();`</small> | Read elapsed microseconds; both targets have only 1000-microsecond resolution. |
| [`void delay(unsigned long)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-delay)<br><small>*Example:* `delay(10);`</small> | Does nothing on the device or in the app emulator - use millis() timing. |
| [`void delayMicroseconds(unsigned int)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-delaymicroseconds)<br><small>*Example:* `delayMicroseconds(100);`</small> | Does nothing on the device or in the app emulator - use millis() timing. |
| [`long random(long maxExclusive)`<br>`long random(long minInclusive, long maxExclusive)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-random)<br><small>*Example:* `int roll = random(1, 7);`</small> | Choose an integer from the first bound inclusive to the second exclusive; one argument starts at 0. |
| [`void randomSeed(unsigned long)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-randomseed)<br><small>*Example:* `randomSeed(42);`</small> | Does nothing in studio apps, on the device and in the browser emulator. |
| [`long map(long x, long in_min, long in_max, long out_min, long out_max)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-map)<br><small>*Example:* `long brightness = map(value, 0, 100, 0, 255);`</small> | Rescale an integer range; does not clamp values outside the range. |
| [`template <typename T> T constrain(T x, T lo, T hi)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-constrain)<br><small>*Example:* `long bounded = constrain(value, 0L, 100L);`</small> | Clamp a value between inclusive bounds; use long integers on both targets. |
| [`template <typename T> T min(T a, T b)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-min)<br><small>*Example:* `int smaller = min(a, b);`</small> | Choose the smaller of two values of the same type. |
| [`template <typename T> T max(T a, T b)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-max)<br><small>*Example:* `int larger = max(a, b);`</small> | Choose the larger of two values of the same type. |
| [`float radians(float deg)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-radians)<br><small>*Example:* `float angle = radians(90.0f);`</small> | Convert degrees to radians (one full turn is about 6.283 radians). |
| [`float degrees(float rad)`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-degrees)<br><small>*Example:* `float angle = degrees(1.0f);`</small> | Convert radians to degrees (360 degrees is one full turn). |
| [`unsigned long millis_NOW`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-millis-now)<br><small>*Example:* `millis_NOW`</small> | The time in ms when this frame started; read it instead of calling millis() repeatedly. |
